source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the pancreas as an endocrine gland (PDF 64-66).

blocks.text: Pancreas ka zyada hissa exocrine hai aur pancreatic juice pancreatic duct mein dalta hai, magar khaas cells ke dhabbe, islets of Langerhans, endocrine hain. Har islet mein beta cells, jo tadad mein zyada hain, insulin aur alpha cells glucagon chhorte hain.

blocks.caption: Insulin aur glucagon
rows: khoon ka glucose naarmal se gire
khoon ka glucose kam: cells (skeletal muscle, charbi) zyada lete, jigar mein glycogenesis, respiration mein zyada glucose kharch, zaid charbi mein, gluconeogenesis band
khoon ka glucose zyada: khaas taur par jigar ka jama glycogen tor kar glucose khoon mein chhorta

blocks.alt: Baen: gol exocrine acini se ghira bayzavi islet of Langerhans; islet ke andar bohat se neele beta cells (insulin) aur kam surkh alpha cells (glucagon). Daen: dashed gurde ke oopar topi-numa adrenal gland, peeli bahari cortex (cortisol, aldosterone) aur gulabi andaruni medulla (epinephrine, norepinephrine); note kehta hai medulla nerves aur cortex ACTH ke qaboo mein hai.
blocks.caption: Exocrine hisson se ghire islets of Langerhans (Figure 16.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Pancreas ka zyada hissa exocrine hai aur pancreatic juice banata hai, magar is ke islets of Langerhans endocrine hain: tadad mein zyada beta cells insulin chhorte hain jo khoon ka glucose kam karta hai, aur alpha cells glucagon chhorte hain jo use barhata hai. Har adrenal gland ki bahari cortex ACTH ke qaboo mein cortisol (glucose ka tawazun) aur aldosterone (namak aur pani ka tawazun) jaise corticosteroids banati hai, aur andaruni medulla nerves ke qaboo mein lado ya bhago ke liye epinephrine aur norepinephrine banata hai.

blocks.text: Pancreas ke hormones ka adam tawazun

items: Kam insulin: diabetes mellitus (hyperglycaemia). Cells khoon se glucose nahi le pate, to khoon ka glucose zyada rehta; zaid glucose gurdon ka pani wapas lena rokta, to bohat peshab banta, jis se pani ki kami aur gurde ka nuqsan hota hai.
Zyada insulin: hypoglycaemia, naarmal se kam khoon ka glucose, susti, chakkar, ghabrahat aur shadeed surat mein behoshi.

blocks.title: Type I aur type II diabetes
blocks.text: Type I (insulin par munhasir) diabetes: mareez mein insulin banane wale beta cells nahi hote aur ilaj roz insulin ke injection se hota hai; insulin peptide hai aur nigalne par hazam ho jayega. Injection wali insulin genetically engineered bacteria banate hain. Type II (insulin par ghair munhasir) diabetes: khoon mein insulin naarmal magar cells us ke liye kam hassas; kitab kehti hai in mareezon ko insulin ki zaroorat nahi aur woh doosri dawaon, ghiza aur warzish se bimari qaboo karte hain.

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai type II ke mareezon ko 'insulin ki zaroorat nahi'. Bohat se iske baghair qaboo mein rehte hain, magar type II diabetes ke kuch mareezon ko bimari barhne par insulin chahiye hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Be-qaboo diabetes mellitus mein insan bohat zyada peshab kyun karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Khoon ka zyada glucose gurdon mein pani ka wapas jazb hona rokta hai, to zyada pani peshab mein rehta aur insan mein pani ki kami ho jati hai.

items: Islets: beta cells (insulin, glucose kam), alpha cells (glucagon, glucose zyada).
Kam insulin: diabetes mellitus (type I: beta cells nahi, injections; type II: be-hiss cells); zyada: hypoglycaemia.
